_readme: Programme claims and field notes, merged with seed.json by scripts/verify-institutions.mjs. kind "statement" (default): the pattern must match the live official page exactly once and read as a statement about the programme. kind "listing": the programme is only named in a menu or list; it is recorded as partly confirmed. A duration is kept only if its own pattern matches in the same statement as the programme pattern and the matched text itself states the years. reviewed: what a human found when looking for stronger evidence. alsoTried: extra official pages the pipeline fetches on every run so that failures are recorded. pathway links to a course id in src/content/pathways.ts (null = no matching pathway). notes explain WHY a field is unavailable where we know a specific reason. durationNote: a human-reviewed statement that a length of study appears elsewhere on the page; the pipeline checks the pattern still matches before showing it, and it is never recorded as a duration.
